$comment: Gzipped bytes per dist-cdn manifest entry, including every chunk it imports (static and dynamic), each counted once. About 12% over the sizes at 1.0.0; checked by test/size-budget.test.mjs. Print today's sizes with: node scripts/bundle-sizes.mjs. Dark mode (color-scheme-switch) raised site-page.js, site-header.js and tokens.css to about 12% over their sizes with it. bento-box.js (with its four sections) is about 12% over its first size, 19,741 B. Analytics: site-page.js counts its lazy site-analytics (loaded only with matomo-id) and grew by 2,620 B to 36,829 B, so its budget rose by that plus 12% to 39,800; uvalib-analytics.js (the same code as site-analytics.js) is about 12% over its first size, 10,225 B. Breadcrumbs: uvalib-breadcrumbs.js is about 12% over its first size, 10,576 B; site-page.js grew 171 B for the breadcrumbs slot (37,336 B, within its budget). Alerts UI: site-page.js counts its lazy site-alerts (loaded only while alerts are on) and grew by 8,600 B to 46,379 B, so its budget rose by that plus 12% to 49,400; site-alerts.js (with its analytics reporting) is about 12% over its first size, 17,967 B; tokens.css grew 201 B to 1,384 B for the --uva-color-alert-* role tokens, budget 1,550. Analytics v2 (1.1.0): the components that now report (the hours elements, events-section, the filter, date range and breadcrumbs) import the small track* helper chunk (src/base/analytics.ts, about 600 B gzipped; the shared state and site-page's buffer stay in their own chunk), plus their own delegated listeners. site-analytics.js grew 1,287 B to 12,124 B for Do Not Track / Global Privacy Control, data-uvalib-track, spa="auto" (pushState wrapper, route listeners) and the download types; uvalib-analytics.js is the same code. Budgets over their limit rose by the growth, keeping their old headroom: site-analytics.js 12,200, uvalib-analytics.js 12,800, library-weekly-hours.js (+710 B to 16,991) 17,100, library-hours-setup.js (+712 B to 17,595) 17,800, events-section.js (+776 B to 16,211) 16,500. The others grew within their budgets (site-page.js +1,920 B to 48,873). Site name and host buttons (1.1.0): site-header.js grew 465 B to 24,924 B for site-name (its own header template, so the header without a name stays byte-identical), budget 25,200; site-page.js, which bundles the header, grew 507 B to 49,441 B, budget 49,900; tokens.css grew 114 B to 1,498 B for the five --uva-color-button-* role tokens, budget 1,700; base.css now also holds the .uvalib-button, toggle, .uvalib-input and .uvalib-search-form classes (base.css only, no component bundle carries them) and grew from 372 B to 1,463 B, budget 1,650 (about 12% over). Review fixes: site-header.js +369 B to 25,293 B (the site name moves under the logo when the links would not fit beside it: a measured fit with a ResizeObserver), budget 25,700; site-page.js +370 B to 49,811 B, budget 50,300; base.css +435 B to 1,898 B (the dark-mode role tokens it reads, so it works without tokens.css, and the real component tags it skips), budget 2,150. Cards (1.1.0): uvalib-card.js is about 12% over its first size, 14,733 B; uvalib-card-grid.js over 10,547 B; uvalib-pager.js over 12,407 B. Contents and metadata (1.1.0): uvalib-contents.js is about 12% over its first size, 14,850 B (it shares lit/static-html with site-alerts); uvalib-metadata.js over 13,818 B. base.css also gained the five not(:defined) rules (three for cards, two for contents and metadata); its budget is about 12% over the combined size. Pagefind theme (1.1.0): pagefind.css (the Pagefind default UI theme, with the role tokens it reads) is about 12% over its first size, 3,011 B; uvalib-pagefind-search.js (no Lit: a plain custom element plus the track* chunk; Pagefind itself stays the site's) over 3,048 B (its define is inline, so the shared define chunk is not split). Review fixes: uvalib-pagefind-search.js +791 B to 3,839 B (teardown and rebuild on removal, Back and Forward, the template-based count, attribute validation), budget 4,300; pagefind.css +185 B to 3,196 B for the forced-colors tag and loading outlines and the height held before the field is drawn, within its budget. Lightbox: uvalib-lightbox.js is about 12% over its first size, 16,093 B. Photo grid: uvalib-photo-grid.js is about 12% over its first size, 11,276 B. Chip group: uvalib-chip-group.js is about 12% over its first size, 15,668 B (it shares the url-param helpers, now src/base/url-param.ts, with the lightbox). Review fixes: uvalib-chip-group.js +282 B to 15,950 B, within its budget; base.css +152 B to 2,081 B for the uvalib-chip-group:not(:defined) rule, within its budget. Results and badges: uvalib-tag-list.js is about 12% over 13,915 B (with the shared source-children and inline-copy chunks it gained in review); uvalib-results-count.js about 12% over 10,038 B; base.css grew 1,670 B to 3,599 B for the badge, toolbar, empty-state and skeleton classes (and the alert and success role tokens they read), budget 4,050 (about 12% over); tokens.css grew to 1,603 B for the two success role tokens, within its budget. Chip group and results merged: base.css with both branches' rules (the chip-group, results-count and [hidden] pre-upgrade rules and the results classes) is 3,737 B, budget 4,200 (about 12% over). Date histogram: uvalib-date-histogram.js is about 12% over its first size, 18,815 B. Tabs: uvalib-tabs.js is about 12% over its first size, 14,508 B. Card circle media and the actions slot, photo-grid badges, and pager load-more stayed inside the existing uvalib-card.js, uvalib-photo-grid.js and uvalib-pager.js budgets. Tabs merged: base.css with every branch's pre-upgrade rules (chip-group, results-count, tag-list and results-count [hidden], tabs) and the results classes is 3,885 B, budget 4,350 (about 12% over); site-page.js, which installs the same base styles, grew to 50,360 B with them (over 50,300), budget 50,800. Combobox: uvalib-combobox.js is about 12% over its first size, 17,243 B; base.css grew 217 B to 4,102 B for the uvalib-combobox:not(:defined) rules, budget 4,600 (about 12% over); site-page.js, which installs the same base styles, grew to 50,622 B, within its budget. Image regions: uvalib-image-regions.js is about 12% over its first size, 16,871 B (with the region parser chunk it shares with the lightbox, and the heading-level and source-children chunks). Lightbox regions: uvalib-lightbox.js counts its lazy uvalib-image-regions (loaded only when an open image has regions) and the region parser, and grew by 8,440 B to 25,485 B, so its budget rose to 26,400 (about its old headroom). base.css grew 135 B to 4,238 B for the uvalib-image-regions:not(:defined) rules, within its budget; site-page.js, which installs the same base styles, grew to 50,800 B (at its budget), budget 51,000. Map: uvalib-map.js is about 11% over its first size, 18,009 B, measured without Leaflet (the page provides it; the element only uses its types); base.css grew 250 B for the uvalib-map:not(:defined) rule (the key instructions and the map height held above the child list), within its budget; site-page.js, which installs the same base styles, grew with it (see the merged sizes after the pager note). Pager without a known total (issue #4): uvalib-pager.js grew to 13,886 B for has-more and the “Showing N” count, 14 B under its 13,900 budget, so its budget rose to 15,550 (about 12% over). Image regions and map merged: base.css with both branches' pre-upgrade rules (and every earlier one) is 4,489 B, within its 4,600 budget; site-page.js, which installs the same base styles, is 51,055 B (over 51,000), budget 57,200, and site-style.js, which installs them too, is 10,966 B (over 10,800), budget 12,300 (both about 12% over). Styles batch (issues #7, #8, #13, #20): base.css grew 1,385 B to 5,874 B for the scoped [hidden] rules, .uvalib-message, the results list (.uvalib-result-list and its rows, with the two highlight role tokens) and the site-page print rules in the base styles, budget 6,600 (about 12% over); tokens.css grew to 1,709 B for --uva-color-highlight and --uva-color-on-highlight (over 1,700), budget 1,920; site-page.js (52,434 B) and site-style.js (11,512 B), which install the same base styles, stay within their budgets. Analytics for BOV (issues #18, #19): analytics.js, the track* helpers and createSearchTracker as a plain CDN module (no element, no Lit), is about 12% over its first size, 1,183 B. downloads="event" (Matomo's download types, the click handling for download events and outlinks) grew site-analytics.js by about 655 B to 12,831 B, so site-analytics.js rose to 12,900 and uvalib-analytics.js (the same code) to 13,500; site-page.js (51,742 B) stays within its budget. Metadata long lists (issue #16): uvalib-metadata.js grew 1,434 B to 16,306 B for list-limit / data-limit and the Show all toggle (over its 15,500 budget), so its budget rose to 18,200 (about 12% over). Chip-group description (issue #11): uvalib-chip-group.js grew within its budget (16,440 B); base.css grew for the uvalib-chip-group[description]:not(:defined) rule to 4,530 B, within its budget. Breadcrumbs back to the search (issue #17): uvalib-breadcrumbs.js grew to 12,129 B for data-return-from (over its 11,900 budget), budget 13,600. Contents from headings (issue #15): uvalib-contents.js grew to 17,152 B for headings-from, levels, min and refresh() (over its 16,700 budget), budget 19,200 (both about 12% over). Filter drawer and back to top (issues #12, #14): uvalib-filter-drawer.js is about 12% over its first size, 12,779 B; uvalib-back-to-top.js over 11,021 B. Neither adds a base.css rule. BOV issues merged (#7 to #21): measured after every branch and the integration fixes. UvalibElement now installs the [hidden] host rule for every component (its shared chunk grew about 158 B, so every Lit entry grew by that much); with the merged branches the entries left under about 3% headroom, or over, rose to about 12% over their measured size: site-header.js 25,665 B (budget 25,700) to 28,700; site-footer.js 16,483 B (16,900) to 18,500; site-analytics.js 12,981 B (12,900) to 14,500, and uvalib-analytics.js (the same code, 12,993 B) to 14,600; uvalib-date-range.js 11,883 B (11,900, for the uvalib-date-range-value event) to 13,300; uvalib-date-histogram.js 21,083 B (21,100, for decades, auto and following a range set in script) to 23,600; uvalib-lightbox.js 25,641 B (26,400) to 28,700; site-hours-section.js 16,584 B (16,500) to 18,600; library-weekly-hours.js 17,148 B (17,100) to 19,200; library-hours-setup.js 17,753 B (17,800) to 19,900; events-section.js 16,370 B (16,500) to 18,300. base.css is 6,104 B (4,489 B on main before this round; the styles batch, the filter drawer pre-upgrade rule), within its 6,600 budget; the others stay within theirs.
